pageBackedFacts.fact: Program start date assigns the catalog. Degree requirements remain those of admission unless a later catalog is approved; other policies follow the current catalog for each enrolled year.
pageBackedFacts.limit: Historical2024policies are not automatically the current2026rules.

pageBackedFacts.fact: Regionally accredited coursework with B-minus or better is evaluated first against university credit-hour courses; the university then separately evaluates exact competency or GE breadth coverage.
Other-credit awards depend on official documentation submitted to Student Services; coach consultation about degree applicability is encouraged.

The general credit-hour Other Credit Opportunities section specifies25%of degree credits/30for120-credit bachelor degrees but explicitly exemptsACE and listed exams. The CBEsection has its own Other Credit Opportunities language. No30-creditACEcap is established.
ACE recommendations include level and discipline but remain subject to residency and program limitations; acceptance of anACErecommendation does not establish the award for a particular requirement.
CBE bachelor graduation requiresLBSC100, all program competencies mastered, and at least30equivalent resident credits includingLBSC320andLBSC321.
MyPath M means competency mastery at B or better/3.00equivalent; the university does not calculate a competency-programGPA.

No explicit blanket prohibition on post-matriculation transfer credits, no affirmative permission for new externalACEcourses while activelyenrolled and no universal transfer-submission deadline were located in the applicable undergradCBEsections.
pageBackedFacts.interpretation: The dual-enrollment sentence may matter, but does not explicitly identify whether external institutions or noncollegeACEproviders are within scope. Written university clarification is needed; neither blanketyes nor blanketno is established.

pageBackedFacts.fact: Students who take coursework during an absence must provide official transcripts before returning. This is not permission to take courses concurrently and is not advice to withdraw.

The inherited general portfolio policy expressly requires matriculation; portfolio credit is capped30and excludesresidency. This shows a distinct post-admission credit mechanism but does not establishSophia/ACEtiming oreligibility.

The academic record lists mastered competencies; a credit-hour conversion transcript can be requested. DegreeWorks100%completion flags conferral, followed by seven-day validation. Requiredoutsidecredits should be officially evaluated before a completion claim.
